current_prompt.body:
MODEL the protocol as a state machine with states and transitions for both coordinator and participants.
ANALYZE whether the protocol is deadlock-free assuming no messages are lost and all participants eventually respond.
IF the protocol is susceptible to deadlock under message loss, DESCRIBE the deadlock scenario.
PROVIDE a mitigation, e.g., a timeout-based presumed abort.
